question: Does the severe-clean P5F mechanism add enough encoded and perceptual edge value over P5C to justify a later runtime-cost audit, without relying on amplified difference views?

deterministic_metrics.quantization: IEC-61966-2-1 encoded sRGB rounded to uint8 exactly once
deterministic_metrics.changed_pixel: any RGB channel differs by at least one encoded code
deterministic_metrics.strong_colour_edge_mask: top decile of baseline opponent-gradient magnitude per image
deterministic_metrics.flat_mask: bottom quartile of source linear-luma gradient per image
deterministic_metrics.opponent_gradient: L2 norm of horizontal and vertical first differences after subtracting per-pixel RGB mean

blind_visual_protocol.crop_selection: one-to-one crop centred on strongest unamplified candidate-versus-baseline difference
blind_visual_protocol.display: two unlabeled A/B columns only; no source, difference map, candidate identity or metric
blind_visual_protocol.question: Which side has the more natural, coherent and useful colour-edge acuity without artifact?
blind_visual_protocol.tie_rule: tie or no visible difference counts as no candidate preference

forbidden_fallbacks: amplify differences or reveal the key during blind judgement
change crops, thresholds, seeds or tie handling after viewing
count technical safety as visible value
call autonomous choices human or population preference
open runtime integration if either automatic or visual value gates fail

branch_rule.pass: freeze a separate runtime cost and combined-chain ablation before any integration
branch_rule.fail: retain P5F as research-only mechanism evidence and keep P5C as the simpler runtime authority
